snippet.title: Vault of The Vanquished - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
This is my game Vault of The Vanquished! A coin flipping rouge-like where your goal is to build up upgrades and items, to vanquish as many enemies as you can!

Find the game over on steam to wishlist it here!
